title: Show HN: Mole – Deep research agent for your terminal
summary: Mole is a terminal-based deep research agent that enforces strict budget control (0% overshoot), provides verified source citations for every claim, and ensures privacy boundaries for local data processing - addressing common pain points of existing AI research tools.
problem_solved: Research agents waste budget, produce unverified confident answers without proper source attribution, and lack privacy controls for local data.
why_valuable: It guarantees budget compliance, trustworthy citations, and local data privacy - eliminating cost surprises and ensuring research integrity.
